definition.en: Past time counted in millions of years; 66 Ma means 66 million years ago.
definition.zh: 以百万年为单位表示过去的时间；66 Ma 表示6600万年前，不是公历年份。

definition.en: The era containing the Triassic, Jurassic and Cretaceous periods; numerical bounds follow the ICS June 2026 chart.
definition.zh: 包含三叠纪、侏罗纪和白垩纪的地质年代；数值界限采用 ICS 2026年6月表。

definition.en: The earliest of these three periods. The 250 Ma map is a sample within it, not its beginning.
definition.zh: 这里三个纪中最早的一个。250 Ma 地图是其中的一个样本，不是它的起点。

definition.en: The period after the Triassic and before the Cretaceous; it is a different time from the 250 Ma sample.
definition.zh: 位于三叠纪之后、白垩纪之前；与250 Ma样本属于不同年代。

definition.en: The last period of the Mesozoic, ending about 66 million years ago.
definition.zh: 中生代最后的一个纪，约在6600万年前结束。

definition.en: A supercontinent joining land masses that are separated today; it later broke apart.
definition.zh: 过去由多块今天分开的大陆相连而成的超大陆；后来逐渐分裂。

definition.en: Using evidence and models to reconstruct ancient land and sea patterns; it is not a photograph of the past.
definition.zh: 根据证据和模型重建过去的水陆格局；不是远古照片。

definition.en: Evidence of past life preserved in a geological setting, including body remains and traces of activity.
definition.zh: 保存在地质背景中的过去生命证据，包括身体遗存和活动痕迹。

definition.en: PBDB groups geographically related fossil information into a collection; it need not represent one animal or one excavation.
definition.zh: PBDB把有地理联系的化石资料汇成一组；不一定等于一只动物或一次发掘。

definition.en: A record of a kind of fossil in one PBDB collection; one collection can contain several occurrences.
definition.zh: 某类化石在一个PBDB采集记录组中的资料；同一组可以有多条出现记录。

definition.en: The older and younger age limits reported in published information; not an exact death date or proof of continuous survival between the limits.
definition.zh: 发表资料给出的较老和较年轻年龄界限；不是精确死亡日期，也不是在两端之间一直生存的证明。

definition.en: Dinosaurs other than birds; living birds remain within the dinosaur family tree.
definition.zh: 鸟类之外的恐龙；现生鸟仍属于恐龙谱系。

definition.en: A lineage has no surviving members. Some bird lineages survived the end of the Cretaceous, so not all dinosaurs became extinct.
definition.zh: 某一谱系不再有存活成员。白垩纪末有鸟类支系存活，所以不能说所有恐龙都灭绝了。

definition.en: A small celestial body. The illustration is conceptual and does not reconstruct the exact shape or scale of the impactor.
definition.zh: 一种小天体。这里的插画是概念图，不复原撞击体的真实外形或比例。

definition.en: The crater associated with the end-Cretaceous impact, in modern Mexico; its locator point is not the crater outline.
definition.zh: 与白垩纪末撞击相关的坑址，今天位于墨西哥；地图定位点不是坑的轮廓。
